desc: Parse input, store all directed edges, and compute the unweighted shortest path length L from 1 to N by BFS; set the search upper bound to hi=min(L,K).
Implement Dinic max-flow/min-cut and feasible(D) threshold-network construction, including terminal forcing, monotonicity, edge constraints, and unit cost edges.
In main, loop D from hi down to 0 (or binary search), call feasible(D), print the first feasible D, and ensure parallel edges are represented by separate unit capacity edges or summed capacities.
Run sample tests and edge cases (multi-edges, K large, D=0) to verify.
